title: Client patch 4.0.4b예정과 여러가지 사항.
bodyHtml:
FYI 란에 올라온 사항들입니다.

  Client patch 4.0.4b Information Sep 10 2004 12:26AM CST (GMT -06:00)  
We are planning to release a client patch today, September 9th, at approximately 5:30PM PST (12:30PM GMT), which will include additional support for Publish 27 and the following.

2D Client:
Fixed memory leak related to resizing the game play window
Reduced CPU utilization

3D Client:
Improved efficiency

Both Clients:
DVD-ROM drive detection code will now skip examining the a: and b: drives
Localization updates
=============================================
오늘 Client patch 4.0.4b패치됩니다.
나와있는것은 외부적인 패치입니다.
게임진행과는 상관없지만 현재 이에이와 이지유오와의 대결구도이므로 어떤것이 심어있을지는 모르겠습니다.
일단 패치 후 이지유오를 사용하시는분은 절대 이지유오를 실행시키지 마시고 여론을 관찰 한 후 사용하시길-_-;


  Vendor Exploit Policy Sep 9 2004 10:38PM CST (GMT -06:00)  
It has come to our attention that some players have been blatantly abusing the vendor system. These players are making an attempt to bypass the rental costs associated with vendors, and are also using vendors for extra storage in a way that was not originally intended by our designers.

In an effort to provide a fair and enjoyable gaming experience, action must be taken. With that said, any and all 밻xploited?vendors found will have their goods permanently deleted upon discovery. In addition, accounts which are associated with these vendors will be actioned accordingly.

Thank you for your patience as we address these issues to ensure the best gaming experience possible.

Platinum
Customer Service Manager
EA Customer Support  
==============================================
벤더를 개인창고전용으로 사용하지 말라는 경고문입니다.
만일 발견시 벤더는 강제로 제거하고 해당계정은 불이익처리한다는 내용입니다.

  Unscheduled Server Downtime -- September 7th, 2004 Sep 8 2004 12:28AM CST (GMT -06:00)  
All UO servers will be unavailable for approximately 1 hour beginning at 5:30PM PST (12:30PM GMT) for some unscheduled server maintenance and code updates. When the servers come back up, you will not be able to sail boats across sever boundaries. This will be a temporary issue and should be resolved by Tuesday, September 14th, 2004.
========================================
일시적으로 배가 서버경계선을 이동하지 못하는 현상을 9월 14일경 수정한다는 내용입니다.
